field_principles.band_tuned_on_calibration: Methodology - band tuned on calibration, evaluated held-out; no leakage; reuses exp3926 per-item judge scores.
field_principles.cascade_auroc: Accuracy of the classifier-first cascade - should approach the competent-judge AUROC.
field_principles.cascade_cost_ratio: BARE FLOAT - pure_judge_cost / cascade_cost; the deployable 'Nx cheaper at matched accuracy' number.
field_principles.cascade_degenerate: BARE BOOL - true if escalation_fraction==0 (the .362 failure mode); blocks any WINS claim.
field_principles.escalation_fraction: BARE FLOAT - fraction escalated; MUST be > 0 (the .362 positive-control failure was escfrac=0.0).
field_principles.inference_substrate: Methodology - aggregation substrate; reuses exp3926 per-item judge scores (aggregation substrate, no live model).
field_principles.n_calibration: Methodology - calibration split size used only for band tuning.
field_principles.n_heldout: Methodology - heldout split size used for reported metrics.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Methodology - cached Exp 3926 score, cost, and positive-control evidence checked before aggregation.
field_principles.pure_judge_auroc: The pure-competent-judge baseline the cascade must (near-)match.
field_principles.random_seed: Methodology - deterministic split and reproducibility seed.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Methodology - hash over upstream artifact, split, tuned band, costs, and heldout scores.
